exposure: fasting plasma glucose (FPG) within 24-48 h postpartum
outcome: abnormal 6-12-week postpartum oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: The study included 3128 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and singleton pregnancies who had FPG levels recorded 24-28 h postpartum and underwent a 6-12-week OGTT.
finding: Normal 24-48 h FPG readings, especially in low-risk GDM cases, had a high negative predictive value (99.3%) for type-2 diabetes at the 6-12-week OGTT, but a lower NPV (85.8%) for predicting future glucose intolerance.
